viewer: Hindi-speaking hostel students scrolling alone at night
hook: रात को शीशे में अपने पीछे कोई दिखे... तो मुड़कर मत देखना।
payoff: Rohan texts that he reached home; the thing in his bed, visible only in the mirror, opens its eyes.
belief_label: invented family rule framed as a grandmother's saying; not a sourced tradition

choice.question: मुड़ूँ, या देखता रहूँ?
choice.deadline_note: Votes counted 24 h after posting; pin the comment 'A या B? कमेंट करो' as the first comment.

story.setup: A hostel student alone over Diwali brushes his teeth at night; his roommate Rohan went home at six.

rule_or_clue.text: मुड़ोगे, तो वो जान जाएगा कि तुमने उसे देख लिया

rule_or_clue.line: शाम छह बजे घर चला गया था

escalation.text: the towel covering the mirror falls
someone sleeps in Rohan's bed, in the mirror
escalation.line: रोहन के बिस्तर पर कोई सो रहा था
कंबल धीरे-धीरे ऊपर-नीचे हो रहा था

twist.text: Rohan texts that he reached home
twist.how: Rohan is home, so the sleeper exists only in the mirror: it is the one the rule says not to turn toward.

story.part_question: रोहन के बिस्तर पर कौन सो रहा है?

part_payoff.text: it is not Rohan, and it opens its eyes in the mirror

ending_image.text: the mirror: his own face in the foreground, the thing's open eyes behind him

callback.text: the turn-around rule returns as the choice

new_facts: Part 1: the thing sleeps in Rohan's bed and is visible only in the mirror
story.scare_pattern: reflection opens its eyes after a phone-message twist
